REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - FEBRUARY 27, 2018 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA
90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1203. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to
the Property Preservation Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Approval of Minutes for January 30, 2018
5.
Public Comments
6.
Public Hearing Items
A.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 12108 Smokie Lane, Cerritos, California, 90703, has an inoperable vehicle stored in public view, a lack of landscape maintenance, debris stored in public view, and is in an unsightly condition which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7054-028-044).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2018-7
B.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 17308 Cortner Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has inoperable vehicles stored in public view, structure exteriors in need of repair and paint, trash cans stored in an area visible from the public street, and dying vegetation which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7025-006-023).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2018-8
C.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 18012 Pires Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of landscape maintenance, weeds, a lack of adequate ground cover, structure exteriors in need of repair or paint, and vehicles parked on unapproved areas which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7027-016-013).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2018-9
D.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 12356 Reva Street, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of adequate ground cover, dead vegetation, debris stored in an area visible from the public street, and exterior structures in need of repair and paint which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7025-024-023).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2018-10
E.
An appeal of an administrative determination by the Parks Superintendent denying a request to remove one parkway tree adjacent to the property located at 18318 Jeffrey Avenue, California, 90703 (APN 7028-014-002).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. TR 2018-4
F.
An appeal of an administrative determination by the Parks Superintendent denying a request to remove one parkway tree adjacent to the property located at 12422 Eckleson Street, California, 90703 (APN 7056-007-046).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. TR 2018-5
7.

8.
Communications from the Property Preservation Commission and Report on Meetings
9.
Adjournment
